title: Surface code, distance 3 (17 qubits) on cyclone_base — a loop with no junctions
claim: Cyclone's base: rotation on a loop without spurs

marks.label: cool
marks.note: the lattice cools too; 13% of its round.

marks.label: a typical shuttle
marks.note: a handful of ions, each on its own route: the 80% of this round that is transport is made of instructions like this one.

marks.label: the busiest shuttle (3 ions) / 2 directions at once
marks.note: the most ions this router ever moves at once, against a ring rotation's 144. The mean is 1.3. The device declares 18 SIMD classes (row and column shifts); the router issues only `shuttle`.  ALSO: ions moving 2 different ways in one instruction. A ring rotation asks for one. On the 32-channel broadcast block this needs 2 channels -- legal, and the reason q06h's 'a lattice cannot use broadcast' was withdrawn.

title: Surface code, distance 3 (17 qubits) on ring(12, 2, 8) — a small ring with 8 docks
claim: the study's family at the code's scale: 24 slots, 8 dock spurs

marks.label: batch 1 of 18 / a 1-contact batch (12 of 18)
marks.note: a dock: 1 riders pull into their spurs at once. Each batch pays dock + undock + one forced cool (about 725 us) whatever its size; mean fill here is 1.3 contacts of 2 possible.  ALSO: one rider docks alone, and the batch still pays its full overhead: 12 such batches cost about 8.8 ms for 50.0% of the contacts.

marks.label: forced cool
marks.note: 300 us, once per batch: an ion that has crossed a junction carries 3 quanta against a 1-quantum gate budget, so the cool is structural, not a policy. It is about a quarter of the round.

marks.label: contact gates (1 pairs at once)
marks.note: the two-qubit gates of one batch, all in one instruction; each pair sits in its own dock. The Circuit pane shows which QASM statements this discharges.

marks.label: undock
marks.note: the riders leave their spurs. Entering the degree-3 rail node is charged as a junction crossing -- the price of the only mechanism a loop has.

marks.label: rigid rotation
marks.note: one loop_shift template turns the whole loop: every rider moves with one waveform. This is the broadcast primitive the ring is built around, and the reason it moves 72 ions per transport instruction.

marks.label: the fullest batch (2 contacts)
marks.note: every ancilla in use at once: this is what the lockstep placement is engineered to make happen, and the per-batch overhead is amortised best here.
